description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Jarvan IV''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|leaps]] with [[File:Unstoppable icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Displacement immune]] [[:Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|displacement immunity]] to the target enemy champion's location over 0.35 seconds, dealing physical damage to all nearby enemies upon arrival.
description.text: Active: Jarvan IV leaps with displacement immunity to the target enemy champion's location over 0.35 seconds, dealing physical damage to all nearby enemies upon arrival.

description2.raw: Upon impact, he creates a circle of impassable terrain that [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocks aside]] enemies within the perimeter over 0.15 seconds, knocking them out of the circle if they are on the outer edge and pulling them in otherwise. The terrain lasts for 3.5 seconds and grants [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area. ''Cataclysm'' can be recast after 0.75 seconds while the terrain is present.
description2.text: Upon impact, he creates a circle of impassable terrain that knocks aside enemies within the perimeter over 0.15 seconds, knocking them out of the circle if they are on the outer edge and pulling them in otherwise. The terrain lasts for 3.5 seconds and grants sight of the area. Cataclysm can be recast after 0.75 seconds while the terrain is present.

description3.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Jarvan IV''' destroys the terrain created by ''Cataclysm''.
description3.text: Recast: Jarvan IV destroys the terrain created by Cataclysm.

leveling.raw:

notes.raw: * The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. ** If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger without being considered as an ability activation. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will block the damage but not the terrain generation. * If '''Jarvan IV's''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|leap]] is interrupted by another by another forced movement (eg. old [[File:Skarner OriginalSquare old.png|20xpx|border|link=Skarner|An icon representing Skarner]] [[Skarner|Skarner's]] [[File:Skarner Impale old2.png|20xpx|border|link=Skarner#Impale old2|An icon for Skarner's ability Impale old2]] [[Skarner#Impale old2|Impale]][https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/njwmqn/skarners_ultimate_ignores_unstoppability/ Jarvan IV R vs old Skarner R]), the terrain will be generated at '''Jarvan IV's''' location when the forced movement ends. * ''Cataclysm'' will not deal damage, generate terrain, nor refund its cooldown if '''Jarvan IV''' is killed while leaping. * The perimeter is made up of 24 units with 95 [[File:Pathing radius.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Pathing radius]] [[:Unit collision|pathing radius]], 65 [[File:Gameplay radius.png|20px|link=Unit size|An icon representing the keyword Gameplay radius]] [[:Unit size|gameplay radius]] and 1350 [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] radius each. Only every other unit is rendered visible. * [[File:Ornn OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Ornn|An icon representing Ornn]] [[Ornn|Ornn's]] [[File:Ornn Searing Charge.png|20xpx|border|link=Ornn#Searing Charge|An icon for Ornn's ability Searing Charge]] [[Ornn#Searing Charge|Searing Charge]] will not destroy the whole ring but only the part that [[File:Ornn OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Ornn|An icon representing Ornn]] [[Ornn]] collides with.
notes.text:
The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
* If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger without being considered as an ability activation.
Spell shield will block the damage but not the terrain generation.
If Jarvan IV's leap is interrupted by another by another forced movement (eg. old Skarner's Impale[https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/njwmqn/skarners_ultimate_ignores_unstoppability/ Jarvan IV R vs old Skarner R]), the terrain will be generated at Jarvan IV's location when the forced movement ends.
Cataclysm will not deal damage, generate terrain, nor refund its cooldown if Jarvan IV is killed while leaping.
The perimeter is made up of 24 units with 95 pathing radius, 65 gameplay radius and 1350 sight radius each. Only every other unit is rendered visible.
Ornn's Searing Charge will not destroy the whole ring but only the part that Ornn collides with.
